_om: Hjulet in English (Wheelie, rusj.no/en/wheelie/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The fields, truths, challenges, categories and rules are in data.en/hjul.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Lykkehjul med tolv felt: Wheel of fortune with twelve fields
Gi det mer fart – eller trykk på knappen: Give it more speed – or press the button!
Skriv regelen – mobilen husker den: Type the rule – the phone remembers it
Trykk på knappen – eller gi hjulet et sp: Press the button – or give the wheel a spin with your finger.
Hjulet bestemmer! Dere snurrer etter tur: The wheel decides! You take turns to spin, and the field it stops on says what happens. Small sips only – and alcohol-free counts just as much.
Trykk på knappen, trykk på hjulet eller: Press the button, tap the wheel or give it a spin with your finger.
Les feltet høyt. En slurk er en liten sl: Read the field out loud. A sip is a small sip of whatever you're drinking – water and soft drinks count just as much.
Neste spiller snurrer. Når dere avslutte: The next player spins. When you finish, the wheel crowns its favourite.
Alle kan stå over – også slurken. Ingen: Anyone can sit out – the sip too. Nobody needs to explain.
Etter hvert tiende snurr er det vannpaus: After every tenth spin there's a water break, and the wheel has its own water field.
Lag husregler: Gi feltene egne navn og o: Make house rules: give the fields your own names and tasks. The phone remembers them for next time.
Utfordringene er trygge og passer i en s: The challenges are safe and fit in a living room. If one doesn't suit, tap 🎲 for a new one.
Spis og drikk vann underveis, og sørg fo: Eat and drink water as you go, and make sure everyone gets home safely.
Sit in the same order as the list. The phone goes to the left.
Gi feltene egne navn og regler – mobilen: Give the fields your own names and rules – the phone remembers them.
A sip is a small sip – never more.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit out.
Etter hvert tiende snurr tar alle en van: After every tenth spin, everyone has a water break.
Navn på feltet «{navn}», maks {n} tegn: Name for the field ‘{navn}’, up to {n} characters
Skriv over navnet eller teksten på felte: Type over the name or text of the fields you want to change. If a field gets new text, the wheel shows only that – with no suggestions. Truth and Challenge keep their questions if you only change the name.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye · alle kan: Alcohol-free counts too · anyone can sit out
Alle tar en god slurk vann før hjulet sn: Everyone has a good sip of water before the wheel spins again. Your body will thank you – and the night lasts longer.
Mest flaks på hjulet – skål for gjengen!: Luckiest on the wheel – cheers to the crew!
Remember water, food and a safe way home.
Alle feltene får tilbake sine vanlige na: All the fields go back to their usual names and rules.
Hjulet er som nytt: The wheel is as good as new
Dere drikker sammen til hjulet lander på: You drink together until the wheel lands on Mate again.
Til hjulet lander på Kompis igjen: Until the wheel lands on Mate again
You can always start a new one.
You go straight to the results.
